taskpack.goal: Complete P2-05C by deleting only the disposable clean snapshot after terminal sealing while preserving digest-bound historical replay for deterministic calibration and gate recomputation.
taskpack.integration_policy: verified integration baseline followed by operator review; never merge, push, activate a candidate release, execute P2-08, or call a live provider

observed_errors: deterministic calibration rejected a deleted repository mount source
readiness capability reruns could not discover a newly added cleanup schema before integration commit
failure_contract.infrastructure_repair: release phase2-cleanup-recovery-5a06f6c registers added paths in the Git inventory before integration verification
failure_contract.remaining_code_repair: separate live sandbox validation from digest-bound historical replay validation without weakening live execution

contract.cleanup_policy: seal and validate terminal result first; remove only run_dir/repository; publish a separate immutable cleanup receipt; revalidate sealed result digest after cleanup
contract.historical_replay_policy: post-cleanup calibration may consume only immutable, digest-bound terminal lifecycle and sandbox evidence; it must not require the disposable mount source to remain present
contract.live_validation_policy: all prelaunch and live provider paths continue requiring existing isolated mount sources and complete namespace denial evidence
contract.schema_policy: the cleanup receipt schema is a tracked runtime resource and must be discoverable in copied or reconstructed repositories
contract.promotion_policy: P2-08, live calibration, candidate release promotion, source merge, and push remain forbidden

write_scope_cardinality_policy.exception_scope_rule: all production, schema, and test paths are exact
write_scope_cardinality_policy.exception_verification: focused cleanup, calibration, and readiness tests plus full runtime suite

success_criteria: The complete runtime suite passes on the integration baseline.
The disposable repository is absent after successful finalization.
The sealed terminal result and cleanup receipt remain immutable and digest-valid.
Deterministic calibration and readiness relation reruns pass after cleanup without a live provider.
Live sandbox validation still rejects missing mount sources.
P2-08 is not executed and no source branch is merged or pushed.

policy.semantic_authority: approved Phase 2 v4 architecture decisions plus this failure-recovery contract
policy.repo_map_policy: consume the committed Phase 2 handoff and inspect only declared read scope
policy.trace_policy: one L2 task result plus milestone integration report
policy.merge_policy: integration baseline only; operator controls source merge

tasks.objective: Implement production clean-snapshot cleanup and durable receipt evidence while making sealed post-cleanup sandbox and invocation evidence replayable by deterministic calibration and readiness gates.
tasks.goal_alignment: Repairs the exact P2-05C integration failures without weakening live isolation or deferring cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: The common finalizer seals and validates the terminal result before cleanup starts.
Cleanup removes only run_dir/repository and revalidates the sealed result digest afterwards.
A schema-valid immutable receipt binds run identity, sealed result digest, pre/post digest, and removed, already_absent, or failed status.
Cleanup failure preserves the terminal result and is visible in projection, show, and comparison; a missing receipt remains incomplete.
Post-cleanup deterministic calibration and readiness relation reruns validate digest-bound historical sandbox evidence without requiring deleted mount sources.
Prelaunch and live sandbox loaders still reject missing mount sources and cannot opt into historical replay mode.
Focused cleanup, calibration, live-validation, and readiness tests pass before the complete runtime suite.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if the solution mutates the sealed result, retains the disposable snapshot, skips calibration or gate recomputation, or weakens live provider mount validation.
